name: bound-contrast
review: A useful contrast is supplied. Keep each coach’s reaction attributed, without treating either as the whole team’s mood.

source.headline: Cedar Comets coaches differ over Friday training plan
source.context: Cedar Comets plan an extra training session on Friday. Coach Adair said, "I welcome the extra session." Coach Blake said, "I am concerned about fatigue." No player or supporter reaction was reported.

name: role-provided
review: Ellis is explicitly a supporter. Hope is attributed to Ellis; do not make it unanimous or invent a season turnaround.

source.headline: Cedar Comets supporter hopeful after Tuesday win
source.context: Cedar Comets supporter Ellis said, "I feel hopeful after Tuesday’s win." The report interviewed no other supporters.

name: byline-and-qualification
review: The writer is Rowan Vale, the speaker is Taylor Reed. Preserve both the win and passing qualification, without a next-game claim.

source.headline: Cedar Comets player welcomes win but questions performance
source.context: By Rowan Vale. Cedar Comets guard Taylor Reed said, "I am glad we won, but our passing still needs work." The report does not discuss the next game.

name: headline-binds-subject
review: The supplied publisher headline binds the appointment and speaker to Cedar Comets. Pride belongs to Lane; other players’ feelings are unknown.

source.headline: Cedar Comets appoint Avery Lane as captain
source.context: Lane said, "I am proud of the appointment." No reaction from other players was included.
